body:
When the Design page loads, or when switching away from it to another page, Solace becomes nearly unresponsive for a moment.

Loading the Design page and switching to or from it should not make Solace stop responding.

### For the agent
The cause is not known yet; find it as part of this task and fix it. Places worth checking first (cursory, not confirmed): the Design page's first load and replay of runs and designs (`design.settle`, its `reload`), drawing large designs or flow diagrams, and the shell's watchers over every page's shadow DOM (`watch_shadow_hosts` in `shell.mjs`), which observe each page and could do heavy work when a page is shown or hidden. Report what the cause was in your notes.
title: design: page stops freezing Solace
